note: A record-level timestamp with a non-Z offset (spec 4.3). Spec 8 originally listed this under must-REJECT; that contradicted 6.2, whose refusal list is exactly two entries - a non-finite number and a version too new - and whose rule for an unusable VALUE is drop-and-diagnose. Refusing here would throw away every pip of a track over a badly spelled date, which is wildly disproportionate. The spec was corrected 2026-09-01; the geometry and the pip times, which are integers and unaffected, all survive.

diagnostics.message: must be UTC with a Z suffix
